question.text: A tangent and a normal are drawn at the point <math><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>8,8</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> on the parabola <math><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi></math> which cuts the axis of the parabola at the points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math> respectively. If the centre of the circle through <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math>, then the sum of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mi>P</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">∠</mi><mi>P</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to
